ai.summary: Xalgorix, an open-source AI penetration testing tool, checks its work before it reports anything. When its main agent finds a bug, a second agent has to exploit that bug again. If the second agent can’t prove the bug is real or rule it out, Xalgorix keeps the finding and flags it for a person to review. The check targets false positives, findings that look like vulnerabilities and turn out to be harmless.
